column1: # Native model defaults for generic plugin agents (Claude Code and OpenCode).
# When a role runs on engine "native" (the default outside Antigravity), it does the
# work itself instead of acting as a Haiku driver for Gemini. Antigravity already runs
# - Same 4-column TSV format and validation rules as `.agents/roster/tiers.tsv`.
# - Claude Code accepts opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|inherit or a full claude-* id,
# - OpenCode accepts a full provider/model id or "-" meaning the user's session model
#   (null in tier-defaults.mjs, and no model:/reasoningEffort: lines in generic agent files).
